MobileHome.title: Containerized Mobile Homes & Regional Expansion
MobileHome.subtitle: High-quality, container-transportable modular living spaces (30 sqm, 50 sqm, 80-100 sqm) equipped with self-sustaining solar systems, optimized for European export and African regional assembly.
MobileHome.feature1Desc: Quick and simple installation worldwide using standard marine container logistics.
MobileHome.feature2Desc: Utilizing local workforce in West African (Abidjan) and Southern African (Lusaka) assembly hubs.
MobileHome.feature3Desc: Highly optimized shipping volume of flat-packed modular units assembled locally.
MobileHome.b2bTitle: Strategic and Financial Benefits for Manufacturing Partners
MobileHome.b2bSubtitle: The logistics and assembly franchise structure of HOMLAMENTOR KFT provides direct financial and competitive advantages in international markets.
MobileHome.b2bCard1Desc: Exporting finished houses from Europe is uncompetitive due to immense shipping rates. By importing flat-packed containerized systems for local assembly at the HOMLAMENTOR KFT hub, 100% of the logistics savings convert straight into net operational profit.
MobileHome.b2bCard2Desc: Utilizing the highly trained local labor force at the Abidjan/Ivory Coast logistics and distribution center reduces assembly and manufacturing wage costs by 50%.
MobileHome.b2bCard3Desc: Local manufacturing and assembly entities established in West Africa enjoy special corporate tax exemptions (tax holidays) and regional custom duty benefits under free trade agreements (ECOWAS).
